title: The Last Ember of Aurelion
premise: A disgraced dragon knight must escort the last dragon egg across a war-torn continent while hunted relentlessly by a necromancer king who seeks to corrupt its power and resurrect an empire of undead dragons.
logline: A fallen dragon knight and unlikely allies race across a dying realm to protect the final dragon egg before a necromancer king can turn it into the heart of an undead apocalypse.

visualTone.cameraLenses: Panavision C-Series Anamorphic, 40mm T2.8 and 75mm T2.3
visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Mythic naturalism with volumetric rim-lighting, motivated practical firelight, and celestial backlighting

sets.name: Ashen Dragon Bastion
sets.description: Collapsed mountain fortress carved into black volcanic stone with shattered dragon statues, broken battlements, and wind-scoured courtyards
sets.atmosphere: Cold alpine winds, drifting ash, distant thunder, clear mountain air
sets.lighting: Overcast daylight with shafts of sunlight piercing storm clouds

sets.name: Whisperwood Crossing
sets.description: Ancient forest trail beneath colossal silver-barked trees tangled with roots and luminous moss
sets.atmosphere: Misty woodland air, floating spores, birdsong mixed with distant howls
sets.lighting: Filtered emerald sunlight through dense canopy

sets.name: Sunscar Canyon
sets.description: Vast sandstone canyon split by a narrow caravan route and towering weathered cliffs
sets.atmosphere: Dry winds, blowing sand, echoing stone acoustics
sets.lighting: Golden afternoon sunlight with long dramatic shadows

sets.name: Ruins of Eldergate
sets.description: Abandoned marble city overgrown with vines and fractured arches surrounding a sacred dragon shrine
sets.atmosphere: Still air, drifting petals, haunting silence
sets.lighting: Soft twilight illumination with moonlit highlights

sets.name: Celestial Dragon Sanctum
sets.description: Gigantic crystalline temple atop a mountain summit with glowing runes and floating stone bridges
sets.atmosphere: Thin crisp air, magical energy currents, distant dragon calls
sets.lighting: Radiant starlight mixed with blue-white crystal glow

scenes.name: The Oath Renewed
scenes.description: Cold mountain fortress, steel-blue palette, volcanic textures, windswept atmosphere

shots.description: Age 38, sharp jawline, deep-set gray eyes, shoulder-length dark hair streaked with silver, burn scar across left cheek wearing battle-worn dragon knight armor with layered steel plates, weathered crimson cloak and dragon crest carrying a large obsidian-scaled egg veined with molten gold light within a collapsed mountain fortress carved into black volcanic stone with shattered dragon statues
shots.action: Disgraced Dragon Knight lifts the Last Dragon Egg from a stone altar and says 'I failed the dragons once. Not again.' Camera tracks forward over 5 seconds as wind whips his cloak. Audio includes distant thunder and solemn strings.

shots.description: Age 24, oval face, bright green eyes, auburn braided hair, faint rune tattoo on neck wearing fitted ranger coat, hooded mantle, utility belts and woodland boots studying an ancient parchment displaying magical celestial routes in a collapsed mountain fortress carved into black volcanic stone with shattered dragon statues
shots.action: Forest Guide unfolds the Starfire Map and says 'The canyon passage is our fastest route.' Camera cranes downward toward the map over 5 seconds. Audio mixes wind ambience and rising adventure music.

shots.description: Disgraced Dragon Knight facing Forest Guide inside a collapsed mountain fortress carved into black volcanic stone with shattered dragon statues
shots.action: Forest Guide says 'Then trust me.' Disgraced Dragon Knight nods and replies 'Lead the way.' Camera slowly dollies sideways for 5 seconds. Audio features rattling chains and soft orchestral resolve.

scenes.name: Hunted Through The Wilds
scenes.description: Emerald forests and sunlit canyon terrain, organic textures, escalating tension

shots.description: Disgraced Dragon Knight carrying a large obsidian-scaled egg veined with molten gold light among ancient forest trail beneath colossal silver-barked trees tangled with roots and luminous moss
shots.action: Disgraced Dragon Knight rushes down the forest path protecting the Last Dragon Egg. He says 'Keep moving.' Camera tracks beside him for 5 seconds. Audio includes pounding footsteps and urgent percussion.

shots.description: Age 19, narrow face, amber eyes, unruly black hair, small nose scar wearing slim dark tunic, light armor pads, scarf and climbing gear among ancient forest trail beneath colossal silver-barked trees tangled with roots and luminous moss
shots.action: Scout Rogue leaps onto a root ridge and says 'Riders behind us!' Camera whips upward following the jump for 5 seconds. Audio includes snapping branches and tense strings.

shots.description: Age 60, gaunt face, glowing blue eyes, pale skin, skeletal features beneath necrotic markings wearing black ceremonial armor adorned with bone motifs and flowing tattered cape wielding an obsidian staff capped with a crown formed from fused skeletal remains in a vast sandstone canyon split by a narrow caravan route and towering weathered cliffs
shots.action: Necromancer King raises the Bone Crown Staff and says 'The egg belongs to death.' Camera pushes slowly toward him over 5 seconds. Audio includes echoing chants and dark choir.

shots.description: Age 38, sharp jawline, deep-set gray eyes, shoulder-length dark hair streaked with silver, burn scar across left cheek wearing battle-worn dragon knight armor with layered steel plates, weathered crimson cloak and dragon crest wielding a massive silver blade etched with draconic runes in a vast sandstone canyon split by a narrow caravan route and towering weathered cliffs
shots.action: Disgraced Dragon Knight draws the Dragonfang Greatsword and blocks undead attackers. He shouts 'Run!' Camera tracks backward with the charge for 5 seconds. Audio includes clashing steel and war drums.

scenes.name: The Dragon's Dawn
scenes.description: Sacred ruins and celestial sanctuary, luminous blues and golds, transcendent atmosphere

shots.description: Age 56, broad face, brown eyes, shaved head, thick beard marked with gray wearing layered monk robes with ceremonial cords and embroidered blessings holding a glowing blue crystal prism engraved with dragon sigils in an abandoned marble city overgrown with vines and fractured arches surrounding a sacred dragon shrine
shots.action: Pilgrim Healer raises the Sanctum Key Crystal and says 'The sanctuary still lives.' Camera tilts upward with the crystal glow for 5 seconds. Audio includes choral voices and magical resonance.

shots.description: Disgraced Dragon Knight carrying a large obsidian-scaled egg veined with molten gold light inside a gigantic crystalline temple atop a mountain summit with glowing runes and floating stone bridges
shots.action: Disgraced Dragon Knight places the Last Dragon Egg into a crystal cradle and says 'Your future begins.' Camera circles the altar over 5 seconds. Audio swells with triumphant orchestra.

shots.description: Disgraced Dragon Knight beside a large obsidian-scaled egg veined with molten gold light inside a gigantic crystalline temple atop a mountain summit with glowing runes and floating stone bridges
shots.action: Golden cracks spread across the Last Dragon Egg as the knight watches in awe. He whispers 'Welcome back.' Camera pulls from close-up to wide reveal over 5 seconds. Audio features dragon hatchling cries and soaring choir.
